scope: Additive public-source follow-up for the active Ruin Witch and required Ruin Knight increment. It records newly re-consulted evidence and deliberately makes no catalogue or Core behavior change where the deterministic geometry contract remains unpublished.
game_version: The follow-up rechecks the official June and August 2026 Home Village release notes and public secondary pages on 2026-09-20. No consulted source supplies a client replay trace or a fixed-tick geometry/lifecycle specification.

sources.title: The Anime Fury Update is Here
sources.limitations: Reconfirms rubble selection, the 4-second work phase, 2-second summoning window, post-defeat spawn, 2-second follow-through, exclusions and qualitative retargeting. ‘In front’, ‘closest’, ‘nearby’ and ‘nearest building’ have no coordinate system, distance boundary, tie-break, path/collision, acquisition tick or same-tick ordering definition.

sources.title: August Update
sources.limitations: Reconfirms the active ten-Knight cap and removal of health decay. It does not add an effective tick, cap-completion despawn order, spawned-unit migration/lifecycle, geometry or collision rule.

sources.title: Ruin Witch — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: Corroborates parent L1-L4 HP/DPS, ground-only target category, 0.8-tile range and 2-second attack speed. It contains no rubble actor, movement, spawn, Knight lifecycle, collision or deterministic trace, so it cannot close the behavior gap.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines the rubble object’s coordinates, footprint, creation/destruction time, visibility state, reach/arrival boundary, path reachability, target tie-break or re-evaluation scheduling.

No consulted source defines the ‘in front’ spawn offset/facing, the parent-death-to-child-spawn ordering, the cap-completion despawn tick, collision geometry, or snapshot/replay representation required for the Ruin Witch lifecycle.

No consulted source defines the Ruin Knight’s spawn-to-first-acquisition delay, distance and equal-distance tie-break, wall-versus-building path selection, collision dimensions, death/despawn lifecycle or source-verified visual geometry.
The build-identified secondary parent page improves catalogue confidence only; it neither supplies the non-deployable child’s current table nor a reproducible deterministic behavior trace.
conclusion: Fresh 20 September 2026 public-source review leaves Ruin Witch L1-L4 and required Ruin Knight L1-L4 correctly data-only. The existing official 4/2/2-second cycle, post-defeat spawn, ten-Knight cap and zero decay remain preserved, while Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshot and replay behavior remain intentionally absent until source-backed geometry, collision and ordering evidence exists.
